title: spec(system): retire EmailAndPasswordConfig.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset — a completed password reset always ends the account's sessions
body:
security#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj

Blocked-by: #29827

**Maintainer ruling.** In session `session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj` on 2026-11-03, the maintainer first ruled, verbatim: 「一律吊销,不加开关」. A completed self-service password reset always ends the account's sessions, and there is no setting. Later, accepting the seat's analysis (reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` first), they said, verbatim: 「第三批 同意」. Item 2 of that analysis: retire the key.

## What
PR #29827 makes plugin-auth always pass `revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: true`. It also refuses an explicit `false` at the AuthManager constructor and in `applyConfigPatch`. After it lands, the spec key `EmailAndPasswordConfig.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset` (`packages/spec/src/system/auth-config.zod.ts:318`, `z.boolean().optional()`, on the authorable-surface baseline) can hold only one value. Under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, it is retired.

## Change (spec lane; follow the `spec-property-retirement` skill)
- Retire the key with a tombstone. Prescription: "delete this key — a completed password reset always ends every session the account holds".
- Update the comment at `auth-config.zod.ts:308-313`, which lists this key as an `externalVocabulary` mirror example of #14478 ruling B. After #29827 the key is no longer forwarded, so the mirror reason no longer holds.
- Delete plugin-auth's `assertPasswordResetEndsSessions` (it becomes unreachable) in the same change, or in a paired PR if lanes require it.
- Regenerate the baselines and docs. Add an ADR-0087 D3 entry (it narrows: a writer of `true` must delete the key).
- Measured at the analysis: the only writers of `true` are tests (`auth-manager.test.ts:2060/2072`, `auth-config.test.ts:299`), plus `docs/HARDENING.md` references.

## Acceptance
- The key is gone from the authorable surface, and its tombstone prescribes the deletion.
- No producer anywhere writes the key.
- The D3 entry is registered.
- `check:authorable-surface`, `check:generated` and the liveness ledger are green.

Re-check: `git grep -n revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset -- packages docs skills content`
